# Portside context entry point

Read [root AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the nearest component `AGENTS.md` and the
task documents in [the documentation index](../docs/README.md) before editing.
For automation changes also read [.github/AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

Those instructions own product, safety, validation and publication rules.
Preserve existing changes and user data; keep UI and new docs in English.
Check code against documentation and report evidence rather than inferred success.
Do not independently commit, push, promote, publish or change external services.
Current gaps and unverified external state are recorded in [STATUS](../docs/STATUS.md);
architectural constraints are in [DECISIONS](../docs/DECISIONS.md).
